what: A lit photo with the same composition is layered over the unlit building photo, and when it opens the whole panel pulls back from 1.1x to 1x over 4s (cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1), .25s late), then after 2s the lit photo appears in .1s while brightness rises .3 → 1 over 1s with a curve that overshoots once (cubic-bezier(0,.5,0,2.5)), so the lights flare on and then settle

options.delay: Time until the light turns on (s), default 2
options.zoom: Initial zoom, default 1.1 — at 1 it does not pull back
options.wait: Turns on when an event with this name fires on document (e.g. when the loader clears) — otherwise when the panel enters the screen
options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Receding panel (wraps the two photos, without it, no zoom)

from.where: index.css .nl-hero__imgs — hero of the red-brick Western-style building main gate (original index__intro: once the loader clears (intro_open), panel scale 1.1→1 4s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1) .25s, lit photo opacity .1s linear 2s · brightness .3→1 1s cubic-bezier(0,.5,0,2.5) 2s)
from.options: delay: 2; dur: 1; dim: .3; zoom: 1.1; zoom-dur: 4 — the site turns it on when the loader lifts, so the consumer passes the event fired then as wait

note: The lit moment only works with two photos — with just one, put the same photo in lit and use only dim (only the brightness overflows)
